title: Citation
description: One original, authorised source supporting a RAG answer (master plan 12.5, rule 9): source ID, authorised display name, source version or content hash, where in the source when known, availability and staleness, a permission-checked open reference and the answer claims the source supports. Produced by the core's RAG service after the final authorisation and version recheck, never by the model: a model cannot cite a source the retrieval did not return. When no authorised evidence supports an answer the result is the no_supported_evidence error, not an empty citation.

display_name.description: The source's name as the requesting principal is authorised to see it.

version.description: Source version or content hash the answer was grounded on.

locator.description: Where in the source the evidence sits, when known: a page, a section, a record or a character span.

availability.description: Whether the source can still be opened. available: the source can still be opened by this principal. unavailable: it exists but cannot be reached now. removed: it was deleted or the principal lost access since retrieval.

staleness.description: Whether the cited version is the latest. current: the version cited is the latest. stale: the source changed after the version cited. unknown: the core cannot tell.

open_ref.description: Permission-checked way to open or preview the source. It is an opaque reference, never a URL or a path; resolving it re-checks scope and expiry every time.

claims.description: The answer claims this source supports, one short statement each, as verified by the core's claim/source check. At least one: a citation that supports nothing is not returned.

locator.description: A position inside a source. At least one member; span offsets are zero-based character offsets into the source's extracted text at the cited version, end exclusive.

record.description: Record identifier inside a structured source.

end.description: End offset, exclusive. Not before start.

openRef.description: Opaque, permission-checked reference. file points to a scoped FileRef, record to an application record, source to the source itself (resolved by source_id).
